name: Zimru
home: Temple of the Old Gods, Bramblewood
found: Temple of the Old Gods, before the Sphere.
appearance: Tall, stooped, parchment skin over bone, dulled gold vestments.
sayings: If the gods have died, then their law must rule in their stead.
They would have let the world die praying.
wants: Order, and more sacrifices for the Sphere.
dreams: A world held to the old laws until the gods return, or until he accepts they will not.
oddly_also: Sometimes addresses visitors in the plural, as if to a congregation, then corrects himself.
knows: The Bronze Host's movements, through the Sphere.
offers: Sight through the Sphere, for obligations honoured.
family: None living. The temple's undead are his order; Maedra is his consort.
tragedies: Three centuries of perfect lucidity, watching everything he served collapse and be forgotten.
campaign_notes: Voice: undead Tywin Lannister. No contractions; every line a decree. Judges the party's order, not their morality. Will press for the next sacrifice. Stat as greater wight, HD 10+, 5th-level cleric / 5th-level magic-user; level drain on touch, used as judgment.
